notes: I1: uptake is a TGA weight-loss difference between H2-charged (Parr reactor, 10 bar, ambient temperature, 30 min) and uncharged Ca/graphene, heated to 500 C under N2 (a temperature-cycle gravimetric value); the TPD-MS gives no quantitative uptake, and the 2 wt% at 50 bar/77 K for graphene is cited from refs [23,25], not measured. I2: XRF carbon 75.4% and 81.6% (basis unstated; carbon is the majority by mass even if these are atomic %); metal-decorated carbon. I3 judged not met because the only temperature is verbal ('ambient', 'ST temperature' in Fig. 8); the data dictionary treats a condition stated only in words ('room temperature') as unstated and not imputed, and section 3 makes an exception only for 'liquid nitrogen'. Pressure (10 bar) is stated. If 'ambient temperature' were accepted as stated, I3 would be met and the code would be no_surface_area, since I4 fails independently (no surface area for any sample).
